summary: Idaho Department of Lands frame cabin built 1952 on Cottonwood Butte, Idaho County; staffed to 1989 and gone by 1994; road to summit.

facts.status_note: Gone by 1994. Idaho Fire Lookouts says destroyed; firelookout.com says only gone. No source describes what remains at the summit.

access.note: Willhite describes a drive-up road to the top; Idaho Fire Lookouts lists the site as Drive Up. The land is managed by the Idaho Department of Lands. No source gives an access rule or the current gate or road condition.

visit.trail_note: Road to the summit per Willhite and Idaho Fire Lookouts. No source describes the summit as it is today.

events.note: Frame cabin built with electricity for radio relay and fire detection in the Craig Mountain Fire District
A Lewiston couple, Mr. and Mrs. Wood, are named as the first lookouts that year
A Highway Department radio station stood on the summit; the Air Force installation is described as planned in one source and built in another
New metal roof on the lookout building
Still staffed in 1989, the latest date either source gives for staffing
Gone by 1994. Idaho Fire Lookouts lists it as destroyed; the method is not described.

resolved_conflicts.explanation: Firelookout.com says gone by 1994. Idaho Fire Lookouts says Gone / Destroyed. The story says gone by 1994 and does not say how it ended.
A 1955 newspaper report, quoted on the Weebly page, says the Air Force would begin construction in August. Willhite says the Air Force put in an installation that year. The story reports both.

notes_for_editor: Four pages with a consistent 1952 build and 1989 staffing. Two issues to note. First, the end of the lookout: firelookout.com says gone and Idaho Fire Lookouts says destroyed, so the story avoids naming a cause. Second, the 1955 Air Force installation: the Weebly page quotes a newspaper saying construction would begin in August, and Willhite says it was put in that year. The Weebly page also carries a bare 'Removed' tag with no context, so it is not used as evidence. The Lewiston Morning Tribune article about the lookout being unstaffed returned 403 and was not read, so nothing from it is used. A search snippet about the lookout being unmanned after 31 years is unverified and is left out. The record's county 'Idaho' is Idaho County. No record field was in error.
